decisions.reason: The candidate already records the SPS30 connector pinout with SEL connected to GND, so the source clarification does not require a state change.
Selecting SPS30 I2C mode through its SEL pin does not change the candidate's logic-voltage compatibility or level-shifter policy.
The SPS30 SEL connection does not affect main-board panel controls, GPIO mappings, or button wiring.
The source specifies an electrical mode-selection connection and does not change the sensor board's mechanical placement or accessibility constraints.
Hardwiring the SPS30 SEL pin on the sensor board does not alter the main-board connector inventory or interboard connector architecture.
The SPS30 communication-mode selection does not change the standalone USB power source, capacity, or powered 3.3V scope.
The SPS30 SEL pin and I2C mode are unrelated to the addressable LED supply and data-level logic.
The SPS30 remains a load on the switched 5V boost rail; selecting I2C rather than UART does not change the boost-enable or load requirements.
The SPS30 communication-mode connection does not affect main-board 3.3V source OR-ing.
The current-monitoring requirement remains unchanged because SPS30 communication-mode selection does not alter which rails are metered or the monitor topology.
The source concerns an SPS30 electrical connection on the sensor board and does not change main-board dimensions, connector placement, or mechanical layout.
The SPS30 SEL connection does not affect the DCDC1 voltage setpoint, I2C configuration interface, or downstream 3.3V target.
